description: DescribeServices returns the last 100 service events. Older events are dropped — capture continuously via EventBridge if you need long-term audit.

Free-form reason string. 255-char cap means long error messages are truncated. Pair with stopCode (TaskFailedToStart | EssentialContainerExited | UserInitiated | ServiceSchedulerInitiated | SpotInterruption | TerminationNotice) for machine-classifiable signal.
